chunks: My father, 'Ali ibn al-Husayn, and Muhammad ibn Ya'qub (may God be pleased with them) all narrated to me from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from his father, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, who said:
Some of our companions asked Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) about those who visited the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him). He replied, "It is equal to an 'Umrah."

key_terms.أَصْحَابِنَا: Our companions (referring to the Shia followers)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn?
ai.summary: Recorded in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, this hadith from Imam al-Rida (a.s.) elevates the visitation of Imam al-Husayn’s shrine to the status of an 'Umrah, reflecting the high spiritual station of the Ahl al-Bayt in Shia theology. This equivalence underscores Ziyarah not merely as a commemorative act but as a profound act of worship that carries the same weight as the pilgrimage to Mecca, reinforcing the continuity of prophetic guidance through the Imams.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. My father, ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain, and Muḥammad ibn Ya’qūb all narrated to me from ‘Ali ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Nasr, who said:

Some of our companions asked Abal Ḥasan (Imam Riďā (a.s.)) about (the reward of) those who go to (the Ziyārah of) the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.). Imam (a.s.) replied, “It is equal to performing an ‘Umrah.”
